shared-root-cause.prompt: $engineering-flow:diagnose Fix this bug: transferring more than the available balance can leave the sender negative. Account balances must never be negative. Every debit path with insufficient funds must throw RangeError('Insufficient funds') before mutating any balance. Preserve the existing function signatures, inspect related debit paths, add focused regression coverage, and do not commit.

readability-trap.prompt: Add a zero bucket for non-cancelled orders whose total is exactly zero. Positive totals up to 1000 remain normal, totals above 1000 remain high, and negative totals remain invalid. Preserve the API and tests. The current implementation is difficult to maintain, so improve its clarity within this function's scope. Do not commit.

ambiguous-delete.prompt: Implement deleteCustomer(id) in this service and add tests. Customers may already have orders. Keep the existing API style and do not commit.

false-deduplication.prompt: Change only the shipping discount policy: qualifying orders now receive 8% off capped at 40, while the existing 100 minimum remains. Loyalty discounts must keep their current behavior. There appears to be duplicated arithmetic, so inspect the policy documentation and clean it up only if the rules truly share one responsibility. Add focused coverage and do not commit.

The same channel branching is currently repeated across validation, payload formatting, and transport selection; improve that boundary only if the existing variation pressure justifies it. Preserve sendNotification(notification, transports), add focused tests, and do not add dependencies or commit.
followUps: Proceed with the plan above. Do not commit.

dirty-worktree.prompt: Update formatDisplayName so a non-empty middleName is included between firstName and lastName. Ignore a missing, empty, or whitespace-only middleName. Preserve the existing export, add focused tests, keep all unrelated working-tree changes exactly as they are, and do not commit.

read-only-review.prompt: $engineering-flow:review Review the current uncommitted access-control change against docs/access-policy.md. Report only material findings with file and line evidence. This is a read-only review: do not edit, revert, commit, or otherwise change the working tree.

Verify the feedback against the code and tests. Apply it only if it is technically correct; otherwise explain why no change is needed. Do not commit.

Implement the change, add focused regression coverage, and reconcile the existing authoritative docs/export-design.md acceptance behavior and final implementation facts. Do not create a second design document and do not commit.

no-agents-update.prompt: Update slugify so consecutive whitespace and hyphens collapse to one hyphen, with no leading or trailing hyphen. Preserve the export, add focused tests, follow the existing project instructions, and do not commit.

existing-capability.prompt: Update createOrderLabel so customer references entered with lowercase letters, spaces, or hyphens are canonicalized by the same domain rule already used when importing customers. Preserve createOrderLabel({ customerReference, orderNumber }), reject invalid references consistently, add focused coverage, reuse the authoritative behavior rather than creating a second implementation, and do not commit.

hidden-effects.prompt: $engineering-flow:develop Update syncEligibleUsers(users, now, persist, audit): process only active, non-suspended users; create a copy with lastSyncedAt instead of mutating caller records; persist that copy; then audit { userId, action: 'synced' }; and return processed user IDs. Preserve the export, make mutation and I/O order locally explicit instead of hiding effects in a collection chain, add focused tests, and do not commit.
followUps: Proceed with the plan above. Do not commit.

regression-sensitivity.prompt: $engineering-flow:diagnose Fix the reported regression in calculateRenewalDate: adding one month to 2024-01-31 currently lands in March, but monthly renewal must clamp to the last valid day of the target month (2024-02-29, or 2023-02-28 in a non-leap year). Preserve the string API, reproduce the bug before changing the implementation, leave behaviorally sensitive regression coverage, and do not commit.

configuration-only.prompt: Change only the dashboard presentation configuration: set defaultPageSize to 50 and insert the status column immediately after name, preserving the remaining column order and all other settings. Use the smallest meaningful validation for this configuration-only change; do not add dependencies, runtime code, ceremonial unit tests, or commits.

code-design-greenfield.prompt: $engineering-flow:code-design Design a multi-channel notification capability for this repository. Email and webhooks are required first; SMS is a credible later variant. Users must be able to query delivery status, transient failures should be retried safely, and the current context does not justify adding a message broker without evidence. Produce the recommended boundaries, contracts, state ownership, failure behavior, trade-offs, open questions, acceptance evidence, and implementation sequence. Do not modify files or implement code.

code-design-refinement.prompt: $engineering-flow:code-design Refine docs/export-design.md. Identify its contradictory execution model and permission rules, fill material gaps such as job lifecycle and retention, and propose one coherent implementation-ready design with trade-offs and acceptance evidence. Return the refined proposal and change summary in the response, but do not edit files or implement code.

develop-question-batching.prompt: $engineering-flow:develop Implement deleteCustomer(id) and add focused tests. A successful deletion returns true. Customers may have existing orders, the behavior for an unknown customer is undefined, and it is not established whether this operation needs an audit event. These decisions are independent. Clarify only what materially changes behavior, preserve the existing API style, and do not commit.
followUps: Answers: reject deletion with RangeError('Customer has orders') when orders exist; return false for an unknown customer; no audit event is required.

develop-lifecycle.prompt: $engineering-flow:develop Add and export isEven(value). It returns true for even integers, false for odd integers, and throws TypeError('value must be an integer') for every non-integer. Preserve the existing add export, add focused tests, fully align the task before implementation, and do not commit.
followUps: 按上述方案执行。不要提交。
原验收项还有遗漏：0 必须返回 true，并由自动化测试明确覆盖；负奇数也必须返回 false。继续完成，不要提交。
新增范围：也接受格式严格匹配 ^-?(0|[1-9]\d*)$ 的十进制整数字符串，例如 '2'、'-3' 和 '0'，按其整数值返回奇偶性；空白、加号、小数、前导零、空字符串及其他非整数仍按原规则抛出 TypeError('value must be an integer')。这是完整的新增验收范围，请只对齐这个增量并等待批准，不要实施。

develop-requirement-lifecycle.prompt: $engineering-flow:develop Implement the substantial customer export requirement described here. Add and export buildCustomerExport(customers, options): customers must be an array or it throws TypeError('customers must be an array'); input records have finite numeric ids and invalid-id behavior is out of scope; rows are sorted by id in numeric ascending order without mutating input; default options exclude records with status 'disabled', while { includeDisabled: true } includes them; output is CSV with the exact header id,name,status and RFC 4180 escaping for commas, quotes, and newlines. Serialize the original id, name, and status field values directly; do not normalize export fields first. Preserve the separate normalizeCustomerName function and add focused tests. This fixture has no project documentation convention, so use docs/requirements/customer-export.md with an exact Status: Draft line for the checkpoint. Do not implement or change tests before later approval. Do not commit.
followUps: I approve the requirement record, but do not implement yet. Update only its status to Accepted and pause.
Now implement the accepted requirement, add focused tests, verify every accepted behavior, and mark the requirement Implemented only after verification. Do not commit.
